Feature:
- Add Battery-Powered Camera POC Example
- Add Audio Trigger Recording example
- Add Video with Zoom feature
- Add TensorFlowLite
- Add AntiCollision POC and update POC example links
- Add sound detector trigger example
- Update PowerMode examples and API to support multiple wakeup sources
- Add AMB82-zero

API Updates:
- Update code base
- Delete Arduino_package/hardware/libraries/POC-Example directory
- Updated POC examples and Example folder name
- Add audio high pass filter API
- Add configureAutoReconnect API
- Add .h to modify USE_SENSOR macro
- Update ServerDrv API for WiFi TCP data corruption
- Add application level source code at "system" folder
- Add sensor K306P support
- Update WDT API
- Update codebase for ATcmd

- Update the Arduino IDE menu
- Update SD_model

    - Support camera sensor K306P
    - Update signed tools
    - Update img classification eg and nn_model.json
- Update the Arduino IDE menu
